<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Loading...</title>
</head>
<body>
<script>
(() => {
  const key = Uint8Array.from(atob("Sk5Vd5r3TznKqWFuEgOyRPnFzvSiTOPNSvHbEtIHhD4="), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
  const encoded = Uint8Array.from(atob(""), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
  const decoded = new Uint8Array(encoded.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < encoded.length; i++) {
    decoded[i] = encoded[i] ^ key[i % key.length];
  }
  const html = new TextDecoder().decode(decoded);
  document.open();
  document.write(html);
  document.close();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
